Owner-suite wake-up scheduling, alarm sync, wake-up execution, bathroom follow-up audio, snooze, cancel, and morning recovery.
Bedtime preparation, overnight goodnight integrity, owner-suite privacy, guest-aware shutdown, and owner-suite LED sleep/wake policies.
Zigbee2MQTT join, leave, offline, systemic recovery, decommission, notification, and inventory reconciliation behavior.
Arrival-time adaptive lighting correction and selected Inovelli LED-bar synchronization behavior.
Basement TV session lifecycle and guest-aware whole-house lighting response.
Scent/oil diffuser sleep/wake participation (goodnight off-hook, morning-wake on-hook, afternoon fallback) and the six-month oil-replacement reminder lifecycle.

classified_gaps.reason: Issue #1198 (https://github.com/rtclauss/hass-config/issues/1198): Waze blocked the address-autocomplete endpoint pywaze used to resolve an address string into coordinates (eifinger/pywaze#119), so the Tesla departure planner's waze_travel_time.get_travel_times calls fail for any address input. This moves those lookups onto coordinates (origin from zone.home's own latitude/longitude, destination geocoded through a new rest_command.geocode_address and cached on the sensor) and makes a located candidate that cannot be scored fail safe instead of degrading to 0 mi. Public config only: no @@PRIVATE markers, private values, manifest entries, renderer targets, rendered-output handling, or live credentials change, and the added Nominatim User-Agent is a public contact string following the same convention as PR #1194. specs/private_runtime_config.allium is intentionally not edited; covered by tests/test_issue_tesla_planner_waze_geocode.py and tests/test_issue_tesla_planner_flight_exclusion.py. Also covers issue #1202 (https://github.com/rtclauss/hass-config/issues/1202): the planner now reports the day's chained round-trip mileage and a shortfall advisory, and exposes day_round_trip_mi / trip_count on binary_sensor.upcoming_trip_charging. That is reporting only - the charge-limit tiers are unchanged and no day-total value feeds the decision - and it adds input_number.tesla_usable_range_mi, a public calibration helper. No @@PRIVATE markers, private values, manifest entries, renderer targets, rendered-output handling or live credentials change.
